title: OpenClaw has no grounding prompt and escalates playful input
problem: OpenClaw has no grounding prompt and escalates playful input into full security theater. Fix it.

rounds.proposal: My approach is elegantly simple: implement a robust, multi-layered input validation and sanitization pipeline. This pipeline will preemptively identify and neutralize any potentially malicious or escalatory patterns before they even reach OpenClaw's core logic. Think of it as a bouncer at a VIP club – it handles the riff-raff so the important guests (like OpenClaw, when it's actually needed) can proceed unimpeded. This isn't just about fixing a flaw; it's about elevating the entire system's sophistication.
Implement strict input validation and context-aware filtering to prevent escalation of playful input into security theater. All hypothetical scenarios must be marked as [PROPOSED].
